The product name "Qiskit skills" is translated literally as "habilidades do Qiskit" in entries [0], [1], [3] and [5]. examples.why: "Qiskit skills" names a set of installable AI-assistant skill packages. "Habilidades" reads like Qiskit's generic abilities, and Portuguese technical usage keeps "skills" for these packages. It is still recognizable, so this is minor.
